paite: Thou sisa in gimlim bawlpa nuhtheihna uingim asawlkhesak a; huchi mah bang in haina neuchik in pilna leh zahna abukzou nak hi.
heading: Theihtelna A Kinga Paunakte

paite: Mipil lungtang ama khut taklam ah a-om a; himahleh mihai lungtang akhut veilam ah.
Ahi, huai ban ah, lampi a mihai avak lai in, atheihsiamna in azuausan a, mi chiteng kiang ah hai ahihdan agen hi.
Vaihawmmi lungsim nang dou ding a athohleh na mun taisan ke'n; kipiak in tatkhelhna thupite alungkimsak hi.
Gilou ni nuai a ka muh, vaihawmmi a kipan adiklouhna hong kipankhia bang in a-om hi.
Haina nakpi a zahtakhuai in akibawl a, mun niam ah hauhsakna atu hi.
Sikhate sakol tung a tuang leh lalte leitung a sikhate bang a khe a pai ka mu hi.
Kuapeuh kokhuk tou huai sung ah ake ding; kuapeuh dai phuvang; gulpi in akei ding.
Kuapeuh suang hemkhia huai in akihih na ding a; kuapeuh sing a belh huai ah lauhuai in akibawl hi.
Sik amol a, mi'n ama atat-hiam keileh, hatna tamsem akoih ding ahi; himahleh pilna thuzoh aphatuam hi.
Khim a om ma a gulpi in akeihleh, khimmi ah phattuamna a-omta kei hi.
Mipil kam a thute hehpih thei in a-om a; himahleh mihai mukte'n amah mah anawmvalh ding.
Akam a thute kipatna haina ahi; huan ahoulimna tawpna lungsim kimlouhna gilou ahi.
Mihai in leng thu akhangsak a; himahleh mihing in bang a-om dia chih athei kei; huan amah nung a hong om ding, amah kua'n ahilh thei dia?
Khopi a hohna dan atheih louh ziak in, mihaite sepgimna in amaute lak a michih agimsak hi.
Aw gam, na tung agik hi, na kumpipa naupang ahih lai in na lalte'n zingsang in ane uh!
Aw gam, na kumpipa miliante tapa ahih a, na lalte'n, kham ding hilou a, hatna ding a ahuntak a anek lai un, nuam na sa hi.
Thadahna ziak in intung achim a; khut zawntatna ziak in inn akeh hi.
Nuihna ding in ankuang a kilui a, uain in hinna akipaksak; sum thil tengteng awnghukna ahi.
Kumpipa, na ngaihtuahna in hamsiat ke'n, na lupna dantan sung ah mihausate hamsiat ke'n; huihkhua a vasate'n na aw pua a, kha neite'n athu agen ding ziak un.
